headline: Tottenham thumped by Brentford in Premier League opener
description: Tottenham's expensive summer rebuild was shaken to its foundations by rampant Brentford on an alarming opening day for Roberto De Zerbi's side.

headline: New season, same streak: Viral Man United fan's haircut challenge continues
description: Viral Manchester United fan Frank Ilett could have been days away from completing his haircut challenge. After defeat to Hull City, he's back to square one.

headline: Return to Sender: Ex-Sunderland man Jack Clarke ruins Elvis Presley kit debut
description: Sunderland's debut outing in their Elvis Presley-inspired pink kit ended in a case of 'Heartbreak Hotel' after they conceded in the 90th minute to lose 2-1 at Ipswich.

headline: Everton start Premier League campaign with 2-0 win over Crystal Palace as Prime Minister attends
description: Thierno Barry scored in Everton's comfortable 2-0 Premier League victory over Crystal Palace to give manager David Moyes one less thing to worry about -- for now.

headline: Carrick describes opening game defeat to Hull City as 'hugely disappointing'
description: Carrick describes opening game defeat to Hull City as 'hugely disappointing'.

headline: Ipswich Town mark Premier League return with win over Sunderland as Jack Clarke pops up late
description: Jack Clarke fired newly-promoted Ipswich to an opening-day victory with a 90th-minute winner to down old club Sunderland.
